raw.rationale: PF-03084014 is a gamma-secretase inhibitor whose selective activity is best documented in NOTCH-driven tumors, especially T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia and some breast cancers, but PRISM lineages here lack leukemia and Notch-mutant breast selectivity is weak; most solid lineages are unlikely to show selective killing at 2.5 µM. Published PRISM/CTRP data suggest little lineage-selective cytotoxicity for gamma-secretase inhibitors outside rare Notch-dependent contexts.
